# AI-MarkDone

AI-MarkDone is a focused ChatGPT browser extension for Reader mode, source-aware Markdown copy, LaTeX formula copy/export, Dynamic Annotation, bookmarks, Google Drive bookmark backup, and Markdown/PDF/PNG export without leaving the original ChatGPT workflow.

## Core Pages

- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/ - Chinese independent product site for AI-MarkDone, a ChatGPT browser extension with centered install hero, feature sections, local-first trust notes, user feedback, and Chrome/Firefox install links.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/ - English independent product site for AI-MarkDone with the same ChatGPT positioning, Reader, Markdown copy, LaTeX formula copy/export, bookmarks, export, Google Drive backup, trust notes, and install CTA.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/features/ - Chinese full feature reference listing Reader, source-aware Markdown/LaTeX copy, formula export, annotations, Sticky excerpts, bookmarks, Save Messages export, Google Drive backup, and settings in tables.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/features/ - English full feature reference for ChatGPT Reader mode, copy ChatGPT to Markdown, ChatGPT LaTeX copy, formula export, bookmarks, Markdown/PDF/PNG export, Google Drive backup, and settings.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/manual/ - Chinese one-page manual explaining why AI-MarkDone exists, where each real plugin control appears, and how Reader, Markdown/LaTeX copy, annotations, bookmarks, export, backup, and settings are used.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/manual/ - English one-page manual with the same control reference and product-use explanations for ChatGPT workflows.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/faq/ - Chinese FAQ covering ChatGPT support, Reader, partial Markdown copy, formulas, Dynamic Annotation, bookmarks, export, Google Drive backup, privacy, pricing, and settings.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/faq/ - English FAQ covering ChatGPT support, Reader mode, partial Markdown copy, formulas, Dynamic Annotation, bookmarks, export, Google Drive backup, privacy, pricing, and settings.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/privacy/ - Chinese privacy policy explaining local processing, browser extension storage, optional Google Drive bookmark backup, permissions, no owned server, no analytics, and Google API Limited Use commitments.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/privacy/ - English privacy policy with the same Google Drive backup, permissions, and Limited Use disclosures for review and user reference.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/contact/ - Chinese contact page for email feedback and GitHub Issues.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/contact/ - English contact page for email feedback and GitHub Issues.
